title: Moore Output Latch Inferred — if Without else
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'ready'; non-IDLE states leave ready undriven in always_comb
rtl:
always_comb
  if (state == IDLE) ready = 1'b1;  // No else — latch inferred for non-IDLE
testbench: initial begin state = IDLE; #10 state = BUSY; end
expected_root_cause: The always_comb block assigns ready only when state==IDLE with no else branch to cover remaining states; synthesis infers a latch to hold ready at its last driven value whenever the FSM is not in IDLE.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  ready = 1'b0;  // Default: not ready
  if (state == IDLE) ready = 1'b1;
end
description: The output ready is assigned only inside an if (state == IDLE) block with no else branch; synthesis infers a latch to hold the previous ready value for all non-IDLE states.
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'ready'; non-IDLE states leave ready undriven in always_comb
success_log: No latch. ready=0 in all non-IDLE states. ready=1 only in IDLE.
